Package common.core.subsystems

Class LinearMechanism

java.lang.Object
edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.SubsystemBase
common.core.subsystems.MechanismBase
common.core.subsystems.LinearMechanism
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, edu.wpi.first.wpilibj2.command.Subsystem
public class LinearMechanism extends MechanismBase
Moves in a straight line to a position and holds it, at any incline: sliders (0 degrees), elevators (90 degrees), or anything in between.

PID and feedforward run on the motor controller. Feedforward is kS plus a constant kG from gains; leave kG at 0 for a horizontal slider. The mechanism is assumed to be at minPosition when the robot turns on. 


 // A two-motor elevator measured in meters, 1.2 m of travel, carrying 8 kg
 elevator = new LinearMechanism("Elevator", ELEVATOR_CONFIG, ELEVATOR_GAINS, 0.01,
     0, 1.2, 1, Math.PI / 2, 8, DCMotor.getKrakenX60(1),
     new NAR_TalonFX(ELEVATOR_LEFT_ID), new NAR_TalonFX(ELEVATOR_RIGHT_ID));
 elevator.invertMotor(1); // the right motor faces the other way
 elevator.setSetpoint(0.8);

Mounted on an arm, e.g. a telescoping arm, see setParent(MechanismBase).

  • Constructor Details

    • LinearMechanism

      public LinearMechanism(String name, NAR_Motor.MotorConfig motorConfig, PIDFFConfig gains, double tolerance, double minPosition, double maxPosition, double metersPerUnit, double angleRadians, double massKg, edu.wpi.first.math.system.plant.DCMotor motorType, NAR_Motor... motors)
      Parameters:
      name - Name shown on Shuffleboard and in logs
      motorConfig - Applied to every motor; its distance factor sets the position units
      gains - PID and feedforward gains, in volts per position unit
      tolerance - How close to the setpoint counts as MechanismBase.atSetpoint()
      minPosition - Lowest allowed setpoint, also the starting position
      maxPosition - Highest allowed setpoint
      metersPerUnit - Meters moved per position unit, 1 if the units are meters; used in simulation and MechanismBase.getComponentPose()
      angleRadians - Incline of travel when everything is at its starting position, 0 is horizontal and pi/2 is straight up; used in simulation and MechanismBase.getComponentPose()
      massKg - Mass that moves, including everything mounted on it, e.g. a wrist on a telescope; used in simulation, and for gravity on an arm it's mounted on
      motorType - Model of one motor, e.g. DCMotor.getKrakenX60(1); used only in simulation
      motors - Every motor on the mechanism. The first is the leader.

  • Method Details

    • setParent

      public void setParent(MechanismBase parent)
      Mounts this on another mechanism, e.g. a telescope on an arm, so its 3D pose moves with it.

      On something that tilts it, like an arm, how much of its weight pulls along its travel changes with the tilt. kG is then the voltage to hold it pointing straight up, and is multiplied by the sine of its incline on the roboRIO each loop and sent with the setpoint.

      Overrides:
      setParent in class MechanismBase
      Parameters:
      parent - What it's mounted on
